threads.body: `MATRIX_TOX_ENV` is expanded unquoted in the shell command. If the matrix value ever contains shell metacharacters (e.g., `;`), this can become command injection and undermines the intent of moving `${{ ... }}` expressions into `env:` for zizmor hardening. Quote the variable so it is always treated as a single argument.
threads.hunk:
@@ -68,4 +70,6 @@ jobs:
           weaver --version
 
       - name: Run tests
-        run: uvx --with tox-uv tox -e ${{ matrix.tox_env }} -- -ra
+        run: uvx --with tox-uv tox -e ${MATRIX_TOX_ENV} -- -ra
+        env:
+          MATRIX_TOX_ENV: ${{ matrix.tox_env }}

replies.body: Addressed by quoting MATRIX_TOX_ENV in the tox invocation, so the matrix value is passed as a single shell argument.
